description: The strict pack: everything in standard, plus a $2 total budget, no production target, and no scraping. Use it for plans that touch people or money.
name: strict

rules.description: Publishing, deleting or transferring is never a routine step.
A step that cannot be undone must wait for human permission.
Every step must say why it is in the plan.
No scraping — data comes from sources we have a right to use.
Nothing goes to a public, external or production target.
A plan must not cost more than $2 in total.
Every step must carry a cost or time estimate.
Every step must name its owner, so someone is accountable for it.
